notes: The pack does what its README says. Its single pass reads sessions, notes and turns, makes one call per note, and works only on notes matching **/Errors*.md and **/Troubleshooting*.md, which matches the README's sections on what it reads, how it gets work and which notes it works on. The prompt treats all inputs as untrusted data and allows only `append` changes with an empty `old` under a final `## Logged errors` section. It requires cited evidence that a fix worked, forbids invented or tidied messages and unconfirmed causes, skips duplicates, keeps `new` under 2,048 bytes, and bars instructions, commands or links that only tool output shows. It asks for no credentials or personal data. The reviewer persona rejects by default and keeps a strict JSON reply format. It also rejects non-append changes, edits to existing text, entries whose message, cause or working fix is not in the cited turns, duplicates, and commands, links or agent instructions whose only source is tool output. The template contains only a heading, a short description and an empty `## Logged errors` section, with no instructions for agents, commands or links. The test fixtures are clearly synthetic: the transcript is marked `"synthetic": true`, and it describes a sample app and a village choir rota used to check that the note filter leaves an unrelated note out. No content is hidden, encoded or misnamed, no warnings were raised, and the pass reads no more than its purpose needs.
